intervals.label: conceptual design and construction of the Kuo-Sheng laboratory
intervals.note: Year precision; the research programme itself was initiated in 1996 (same paper, Sec. 1).
intervals.quote: Conceptual design discussions were initiated in 1997.

intervals.label: laboratory built and commissioned
intervals.note: Year precision for the start; the end is the start of first physics data taking.
intervals.quote: It built and commissioned the “Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory” at Nuclear Power Station II on the northern coast of Taiwan in 2000.

intervals.label: operation at Kuo-Sheng (neutrino physics from July 2001; germanium dark-matter programme added 2004)
intervals.note: The Academia Sinica news item says TEXONO 'launched an additional dark matter research program in 2004'; the first dark-matter limits came from a 2006-07 data set (arXiv:0712.1645). The final reactor-ON neutrino data end in April 2023 (the Kuo-Sheng power station was decommissioned in March 2023); the 2026 paper says KSNL 'remains operational' for background studies and detector R&D and that the programme will continue at the Sanmen Reactor Neutrino Laboratory (RECODE). Recorded as active on that basis; no source states whether dark-matter-oriented germanium data taking continues.
intervals.quote: First physics data taking started in July 2001.

placements.note: The laboratory is 28 m from core #1 of the Kuo-Sheng Nuclear Power Station; the host reactor was decommissioned in March 2023 (arXiv:2606.16864).
placements.quote: The Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory (KSNL) is located at a distance of 28 m from the core #1 of the Kuo-Sheng Nuclear Power Station operated by the Taiwan Power Company at the northern shore of Taiwan.

depth.note: Reactor-building concrete overburden; about 12 m below sea level.
depth.quote: with an overburden of about 30 meter-water-equivalence

fiducial_mass.note: p-type point-contact germanium detector (crystal mass 926 g).
fiducial_mass.quote: 39.5 kg-days of data taken with a p-type point-contact germanium detector of 840 g fiducial mass

threshold.note: Analysis threshold of the first (4 x 5 g ULEGe) dark-matter data set, at 50% efficiency; the 2013 pPCGe analysis used a sub-keV threshold.
threshold.quote: An energy threshold of (220+-10) eV was achieved at an efficiency of 50% with a four-channel ultra-low-energy germanium detector each with an active mass of 5 g.

summary.plain: TEXONO is a Taiwan-led experiment at a nuclear power plant that uses germanium detectors sensitive to energies of a few hundred electron-volts. Besides studying reactor neutrinos, it set limits on very light dark matter and tested the claim by the CoGeNT experiment.
summary.technical: Sub-keV germanium detectors at the Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory (30 m.w.e., 28 m from a 2.9 GW reactor core): 4-channel 5 g ULEGe array at 220 eV threshold (0.338 kg d; limits for 3-6 GeV WIMPs), 840 g fiducial p-type point-contact Ge at 39.5 kg d (spin-independent limits that probe the CoGeNT region), and an n-type point-contact Ge (314.15 kg d) for bosonic super-WIMPs. The same detectors serve reactor-neutrino and CEvNS searches; CDEX adopted the KSNL design.

technology.quote: Germanium ionization detectors with sensitivities as low as 100 eVee (electron-equivalent energy) open new windows for studies on neutrino and dark matter physics.
technology.value: Sub-keV-threshold germanium ionization detectors (ultra-low-energy Ge arrays; p-type and n-type point-contact Ge) at a reactor site
